ValidationScope: Downloaded metadata and researched catalog constraints; no server/game runtime test.

SetupActions.Text: Restart the server after settings are applied. Validate a fresh test world with two players before using this selection on the main world; review startup and gameplay logs.
Use a fresh world for DG_MIVehicles. Its author warns that enabling it in an existing world opens the existing vehicles' doors, hoods, and trunks.
Keep vanilla vehicle spawning enabled for VVR. Adding it to an existing world can replace loot in vanilla vehicles.

EnabledMods.Notes: Author recommends loading above all other mods so later texture replacements can overwrite it.
Author's visual troubleshooting places the depth-map fix at the top of the list.
Author B42 metadata declares no native dependency on errorMagnifier. Workshop co-installation links must not reverse the dependency order.
Author 42.20 metadata requires ChuckleberryFinnAlertSystem; load the alert system first to avoid a dependency cycle.
Load shared library before VMZNEW, VVR, SpecLoot and KI5minifixes.
Uses the Build 42 Workshop item, not the B41 library 2392709985.
Uses the official release recommended by the former TWIST fork. Clients must enable character textures in the main menu and restart.
Author Gunworks family order: Hot Brass before Gunworks before Guns of Marz. Hot Brass itself is optional.
Author reports Build 42.20+ SP/MP support with KI5 vehicles. Use original library, not third-party duplicate fixes.

Use original Build42 item3396446795. Framework2.7 removed PlayerModData.Moodles; old consumer mods may require author updates or the optional backward-compatibility bridge3789490511, whose author warns of possible MP inconsistencies.
Original Build42 multiplayer library. Author says mods using UCWF can compose carry-weight changes, but unrelated mods that overwrite carry weight can still conflict.
Uses the Build 42 Workshop item, not the B41 manager 2694448564.
Author's published range ends at 42.20.x; exact 42.21.0 is not explicitly certified. Validate downloaded version limits and crafting behavior.
Author's published tested range ends at 42.20.4. Exact 42.21.0 support must be checked from downloaded metadata and multiplayer play testing.
Author recommends loading after other food mods. Keeps your requested edition; a separate server edition exists.
Load after its included depth-map fix. Moodle Framework and Bath Towels Overhaul are recommended optional add-ons, not hard requirements.
The previous TacHoldFork exclusion is obsolete because both TacHold entries were removed from the new list. Exact 42.21 animation behavior still requires play testing.
Optional radial-menu add-on uses the base sling mod.
Author supports single player and dedicated multiplayer, including KI5 vehicle snow; known vehicle visual flicker remains.
Uses the maintained official B42 release, together with its Base module.
Author states the equipment locker does not load without 3D Gun Racks.
Current author page supports Build 42.20+ in single player and multiplayer; Bandit Creator is optional customization, not a required dependency.

Transparent edition change to the maintained Build42 continuation. Same author-listed ModId BarricadedWorld; author source confirms 42/mod.info, versionMin=42.0.0, and multiplayer support. Original requested Workshop edition was 2696986935. Existing worlds still need a separate test.
Project Seasons author recommends it above Beauty of Zomboid when both are enabled.
This item lists both legacy and newer submod IDs; select only a matching ID actually present in the B42 files.
This item lists both legacy and newer submod IDs; select only a matching ID actually present in the B42 files.
Author says not to enable in an existing world: existing vehicles' doors, hoods and trunks will open. Set probabilities in sandbox options; visual openings require animated vehicles.

Author specifies Build 42.21. The script checks the requested server version before enabling it. Current version requires 42.21; author reports dedicated-server testing. Avoid another ladder-climbing mod.
Author lists a soft incompatibility with Autotsar Motorclub when riding bikes. Test bike dashboard behavior in multiplayer.
Uses the maintained original, which includes recent B42 versions, instead of the removed STABLE fork.
Author claims compatibility with CleanUI and item/weapon packs, with MP support. Exact pack behavior still requires testing.

Current author title explicitly supports Build42.21+ multiplayer; author describes synchronized vehicle movement.
KI5 vehicle: library first, then base vehicle, then any optional spawn/variant modules. Current downloaded mod.info remains authoritative.
Passenger sleeping requires sleep to be allowed by server settings. Author provides shared Build41/42 package; exact server sleep behavior still needs multiplayer testing.
Author supports Build 42.21 multiplayer and explicitly forbids enabling Vanilla Weapons Plus alongside this pack. Optional tracer effects require a Java mod and are outside this installer.
Hot Brass author currently lists crafting support for Vanilla Weapons Plus and VFE Classic; Guns of Marz crafting support is still marked as planned. Do not promise crafting for all GoM ammunition.
Author describes a Build 42 food-model positioning version and existing-save/server support. Full 42.21 pack interaction remains untested.

Author says these two modules can run independently or together; they are not mutually exclusive. Updated name removes the old ampersand. Author lists 42.20.x support and MP fixes; 42.21 regression needs gameplay testing.
Same Workshop item as removed JustHideDebugMenu, but a different module: this variant also hides build/server information. It should not be treated as an ID rename.
Author confirms B42 multiplayer support and says most gun/map mods are supported. Validate item condition initialization with GoM in the server test.

Guns of Marz author explicitly integrates Load All Magazines. ReloadAllMagazines itself replaces ISInventoryPaneContextMenu.doMagazineMenu, so arbitrary other replacements of that method remain a risk.
Use one water variant at a time; only normal SomewhatWater is requested. Water quality toggle or game restart may be needed after shader updates.

Vanilla faces require vanilla256 body textures. TombBody alone ships models without textures, so this requested combination can use vanilla textures, with SPNCCDetailsHD disabled. Faces conflict with Tomb texture/head addons, not merely the model-only TombBody entry.
Author requires server SleepAllowed=true and SleepNeeded=true. Optional FastForwardMultiplier5 recommendation slows group nights; it is not a prerequisite. Build42.13+ and MP-focused.

Use original author3423984426, not replacement3803208661 with same ModId. Author lists Smoking Sounds Overhaul and I Might Need A Lighter/IDNAL support. Verify moodles, partial smoking, reconnect, and multiple clients on Framework2.7.
Current author states B42.20.3+ SP/MP support and includes a True Smoking compatibility patch. If another mod supplies lighting sounds, choose Puffs only in game options.
Original Tango item supports B41/B42. Author warns new loot only appears in unvisited areas of existing saves; TombBodyCompat covers its clothing meshes.
Original author updated both health/repair items for42.21. Do not silently bypass downloaded versionMax if old cache is still installed.
Author explicitly requires Show Wall Health in multiplayer, although optional for singleplayer. Both original items have just been updated for42.21; downloaded versionMax must match.
Author tested B42 hostedMP and Spongie Hair. Replaces vanilla hat/hair model bindings, so other mods replacing those bindings need direct checks.
Author requires Fluffy Hair enabled in server Mods line, not merely downloaded. Other Workshop listed companions are recommended, not mandatory.
Texture/effect replacement; Blood Pools author explicitly supports blood retextures. Requires a visual/performance check with the complete server pack.
Author states MP support and compatibility with RainCleansBlood and blood retextures. These specific pairs are author-supported; server performance still needs testing under hordes.

TombBody is model-only; vanilla textures are supported. Optional TombBodyTex/TombBodyCustom supply512 underwear textures/heads but are not hard dependencies. Main-menu enablement and a full client restart are mandatory for these model swaps; server enablement alone does not load them on clients.
Author says after all KI5 vehicles. Requires damnlib and YAPZLib. Loot/container behavior needs a real server smoke test.

Author says load after vehicles to restrict military vehicles to military zones. Existing saves get new spawns only in unexplored areas; KI5minifixes was suggested for semitrailer stories but is currently held back for a known issue.
Author warns adding to existing saves replaces loot in vanilla vehicles. Keep vanilla vehicle spawning enabled; the mod replaces them at spawn.
Author labels multiplayer a work in progress that mostly works; overlapping bandage, flashlight and magazine actions need multiplayer testing.
Author recommends loading after all vehicle mods or near the bottom. Add explicit LoadAfter edges for the selected vehicle entries, with VehicleSalvageOverhaulB42 after this base.
Author recommends placing after other climate/weather modifications as a precaution.
Author says no extra dependency, client UI only, designed for Build 42.20 multiplayer; container and magazine indicators do not change capacities.
Author states Build 42.20 stable and MP support. Use original NikGamer item2710167561, not B41 copies sharing this ModId.
Author says Build42 multiplayer works, each joining player gets a briefing. It is not the newer SurvivorBriefing mod with a different internal ID.
Author requires loading after Improved Hair Menu if that optional menu is installed. It is a hair-selection/growth mod, not a dependency of every hairstyle.
Author explicitly supports Fluffy Hair and says not to combine with Yaki Hair Salon (not requested). Retexture should win after hair models.

Full clothing/shoe version is retained. Author labels B42 version beta and42.15 quickfix; current42.21 operation must be checked from mod.info and in-game clothing tests. Tomb footwear patch loads after it.
Author requires compatibility files below every affected clothing mod and a full game restart. Supports Spongie Clothing/Open Jackets, Vanilla Gear Expanded and Boots Expanded among others.
Author explicitly supports CleanHotBar when MinimalHotbar is loaded at the end. This is an order requirement, not a reason to disable one of the two.

DisabledMods.DisabledReason: Requested original has no verified current 42.21 multiplayer support. A separate 42.20 fix exists, but its exact 42.21 server behavior has not been verified; retain the original mapping for opt-in testing.
Author explicitly states multiplayer is not fully implemented or tested; excluded from the conservative server profile.
Author says physical scene generation is single-player only and dedicated multiplayer testing is pending.
Requires matching 512x512 body textures. Default requested TombBody is a model replacement, while the chosen vanilla-face preset uses 256 textures.
Redundant snow visual provider: its author recommends ImmersiveSnow. This is a conservative overlap recommendation, not an author-declared hard incompatibility.
Author states server behavior is not yet tested; dedicated thrown-car spill is untested.
Author only tested a hosted server with one player; animation synchronization to other players and dedicated multiplayer remain untested.
Guns of Marz author explicitly forbids using Vanilla Weapons Plus alongside GunsOfMarz; keep GunsOfMarz for this profile.
Legacy optional texture ID is absent from the current author Mod ID list; keep disabled until downloaded Build42.21 metadata verifies it.
Legacy optional texture ID is absent from the current author Mod ID list; keep disabled until downloaded Build42.21 metadata verifies it.
Original author description only declares multiplayer support for Build41; Build42 multiplayer item loss reports exist. Hold back pending a Build42.21 dedicated-server test.
Conflicts with selected BetterGeneratorInfo: both replace the generator information/range display; BetterGeneratorInfo author explicitly excludes other generator range/fuel mods.

Legacy More Traits is no longer maintained and its author lists an unresolved multiplayer Martial Artist death-sync issue; the older ComputerPers override has not been verified against the current legacy version. Hold this family out of the conservative MP profile until tested.

Legacy More Traits is no longer maintained and its author lists an unresolved multiplayer Martial Artist death-sync issue; the older ComputerPers override has not been verified against the current legacy version. Hold this family out of the conservative MP profile until tested.

Legacy More Traits is no longer maintained and its author lists an unresolved multiplayer Martial Artist death-sync issue; the older ComputerPers override has not been verified against the current legacy version. Hold this family out of the conservative MP profile until tested.
Author explicitly says the original icon mod has not been tested on Build42 stable. Held out of the conservative profile rather than asserting compatibility.
Author archived this B42 icon extension and directs users to a newer mod. Old magazine-menu hooks overlap firearm-menu mods; hold these archived modules out of the conservative MP profile.
Author archived this B42 icon extension and directs users to a newer mod. Old magazine-menu hooks overlap firearm-menu mods; hold these archived modules out of the conservative MP profile.
Author archived this B42 icon extension and directs users to a newer mod. Old magazine-menu hooks overlap firearm-menu mods; hold these archived modules out of the conservative MP profile.
Author says this is now a vanilla Build42 feature, so it is redundant.
Author says this is now a vanilla Build42 feature, so it is redundant.
Author states Build42.13 testing was singleplayer only; hold this optional lighting change back until Build42.21 multiplayer is tested.
Author labels this Build41 and deprecated; Build42 implements the intended off-road behavior in the base game.
Author recommends singleplayer only: local physics can cause multiplayer desync and MP has not been tested.
Current author acknowledged invalid KI5CamperJack recipe input and an update pending after KI5 updates; hold this optional patch back until the current Build42.21 package is tested.
Player retexture customisation is incompatible with the selected Tomb body and the submitted list supplies no required compatible human Spongie texture variant.

The author acknowledged erroneous Tomb incompatibility exclusions in zombie texture variants, but current downloaded mod.info has not been verified. Hold this optional zombie variant until metadata and Tomb visuals can be checked; never rewrite exclusions automatically.
Alternative patch for the vanilla-only Boots variant; this profile selects full Boots Expanded and its matching full compatibility patch.
Alternative to full Boots Expanded. Enable one shoe variant; full SM4BootsExpandedB42 is selected for this profile.
Author acknowledged a recent game update broke the mod and suggested disabling the chime or mod; a Build42.21 bug report is open. Hold back pending an author update/test.
Author describes MP support as ALPHA and several feeding/herd features remain singleplayer-only; exclude from conservative MP profile pending multi-client animal tests.
Discontinued; author says panic is disabled or bugged in B42 multiplayer and the mod currently does nothing there.
Author labels multiplayer experimental and explicitly says no live multiplayer or dedicated-server gameplay session has been tested. Persistence after area unload/restart is also unverified.
Author labels this abandoned and says Build42 multiplayer support needs help. Build42 also requires a fresh save.
Optional author recommendation; enable only when a selected mod actually declares it as a native dependency.
